correctness.rationale: For any prime power q>=2, the normalization t->(1:t+t^q:t^{q+1}) identifies exactly non-Fq conjugate pairs in P1(Fq²), producing δ=q(q-1)/2 ordinary Fq-rational nodes with Frobenius-conjugate branches. Gluing trivial line bundles along the normalization gives geometric Pic^0=(G_m)^δ; descent exchanges gluing ratios and each factor is a nonsplit norm-one torus, with Frobenius -1. PGL2(Fq) is transitive on unordered pairs and its stabilizer is the normalizer of the nonsplit torus, dihedral of order 2(q+1); branch swapping gives signed induced integral character lattice Ind_H^G Z_ε. Exact integral coinvariants are Z/2, not a rational invariant calculation, so group-scheme fixed points are μ_2, including nonreduced μ_2 in char2. For q=5 the subgroup under S5 corresponds to S3×S2 with sign on S3; Pieri multiplication s_111*s_2=s_311+s_2111 gives rank6+rank4. Independently programmed PGL2 signed actions for q=2,3,5 verified pair transitivity, index, stabilizer sign counts and character norm squared 2 at q5. This finite evidence is not the all-q proof.
